# package pubsubstore

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/server/pubsubstore"
```

Package pubsubstore persists the PubSub configuration of a server: "The latest configuration shall be persisted by the OPC UA Server and shall be available after a restart of the OPC UA Server. PubSub components are not persisted, if the component has the optional NotPersisted property set with a value of true" (OPC 10000-14 §9.1.2). A [Store](#type-store) is the server.PubSubConfigurationStore of server.WithPubSubStore: the server writes each change of its PubSub configuration in one atomic write, whatever makes it (the configuration Methods of Part 14 §9.1.3, the CloseAndUpdate Method of the PubSubConfiguration file, §9.1.3.7.6, and the Go API of package server), and restores what it wrote when it starts again.

It is built on package uafx/fxstore, the persistence of the library, as package server/pushstore is: a Store is one [fxstore.Domain](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/uafx/fxstore#Domain) (namespace "pubsub") on an [fxstore.Store](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/uafx/fxstore#Store) backend, by default an [fxstore.FileStore](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/uafx/fxstore#FileStore) in a directory of its own ([OpenDir](#func-opendir)). Each write is one Domain.Apply with the next revision. A write with an unknown outcome fences the store: later writes are refused until Settle has found what the backend holds and, where the write landed although the server did not apply it, has written the configuration the server has back. A server therefore never restarts with a change it did not apply, nor with a part of one.

The records, by key in the namespace:

	root          the Enabled of PublishSubscribe and the Names of the
	              PublishedDataSets and PubSubConnections in their
	              order: a format byte (1), an Enabled byte (0 or 1)
	              and two lists of strings, each a count and the
	              strings, every count and length an unsigned varint of
	              encoding/binary.
	pds/<h>       a PublishedDataSetDataType,
	conn/<h>      a PubSubConnectionDataType with its groups, writers
	              and readers: a format byte (1), the NamespaceArray the
	              NodeIds of the record are in (a list of strings as in
	              root) and the structure in the OPC UA Binary encoding
	              (Part 6 §5.2).

\<h> is the first 16 bytes of the SHA-256 of the Name, in hexadecimal. The NodeIds of a record are mapped to the NamespaceArray of the server when it is loaded; a NodeId in a namespace the server does not have fails the load (ErrNamespace). What the server leaves out is not stored: the components with 0:NotPersisted TRUE (Part 14 §6.2.2 Table 4) and those a server.PubSubComponentOwner keeps, with what is below them.

The records hold the configuration as the server has it, its ConnectionProperties, GroupProperties and the other configuration properties included, which may hold secrets (Part 14 §6.2.2). A FileStore creates its directory 0700 and its files 0600, and refuses a directory the group or others may write. An application that needs encryption at rest wraps the fxstore.Store it passes to Open.

## Variables

```go
var ErrClosed = errors.New("pubsubstore: closed")
```

ErrClosed is returned by a closed Store.

```go
var ErrNamespace = errors.New("pubsubstore: a namespace of the stored configuration is not in the server")
```

ErrNamespace reports a stored NodeId in a namespace the server does not have: the configuration cannot be restored as it was written.

### type Store

```go
type Store struct {

	// Close closes backend

	// restore, when not nil, is the state the store must hold again: that
	// before a write with an unknown outcome, which the server did not
	// apply.

}
```

Store is the store of the PubSub configuration of one server. It implements server.PubSubConfigurationStore. It is safe for concurrent use; its writes are serialized.

#### func Open

```go
func Open(ctx context.Context, s fxstore.Store, o Options) (*Store, error)
```

Open opens the store on the backend s, which holds nothing else: the namespace "pubsub" must be the only one in it. It fails when s cannot be loaded, belongs to another owner, was written by a newer version, or holds records that do not decode or a configuration that is not valid (fxstore.ErrCorrupt). Close does not close s.

#### func OpenDir

```go
func OpenDir(ctx context.Context, dir string, o Options) (*Store, error)
```

OpenDir opens the store in the directory dir with an fxstore.FileStore, creating it if missing. The directory belongs to the store: it holds the lock file and the data file of the FileStore and nothing else. Close closes the FileStore.

#### func (Store) Close

```go
func (s *Store) Close() error
```

Close closes the store, and the backend of OpenDir. Writes after Close fail with ErrClosed.

#### func (Store) LoadPubSubConfiguration

```go
func (s *Store) LoadPubSubConfiguration(_ context.Context, namespaces []string) (*ua.PubSubConfigurationDataType, error)
```

LoadPubSubConfiguration returns the stored configuration with its NodeIds in the namespaces of namespaces, nil when the store holds none. A NodeId in a namespace that namespaces does not have fails with ErrNamespace. The configuration belongs to the caller.

#### func (Store) Settle

```go
func (s *Store) Settle(ctx context.Context) (bool, error)
```

Settle resolves a write with an unknown outcome: it establishes what the backend holds (fxstore.Domain.Settle) and, when the write landed, writes the configuration before it back. It returns true when the store accepts writes again. Every write settles first, so an application may leave Settle to the next change of the configuration or run it with a backoff.

#### func (Store) Status

```go
func (s *Store) Status() fxstore.DomainStatus
```

Status returns the state of the domain of the store: its revision and whether it is fenced.

#### func (Store) StorePubSubConfiguration

```go
func (s *Store) StorePubSubConfiguration(ctx context.Context, cfg *ua.PubSubConfigurationDataType, namespaces []string) error
```

StorePubSubConfiguration makes cfg, its NodeIds in the namespaces of namespaces, the stored configuration in one atomic write of the records that change. It settles the store first. An error wraps fxstore.ErrNotCommitted when nothing of cfg is durable; any other error is an unknown outcome, which fences the store until Settle.
